units.text: Robert is your learning companion in this app. He helps you explore lessons, try today's quest and find your way around.
Robert is not an imam, a scholar or a teacher of rulings. Questions about rulings are for a parent, a teacher or a qualified local scholar.
Robert cannot help in an emergency. He cannot call anyone, and he cannot come to where you are.
If you feel unsafe, hurt or worried, talk to a trusted adult straight away, like a parent, a teacher or another grown-up you trust.
Robert is a helper for learning. He is not a replacement for the people who care about you.
